nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real Banach space, let $a \le b$ be real numbers, and let $\gamma : \mathbb{R} \to E$ be continuously differentiable on $[a, b]$. Then the total variation of $\gamma$ on $[a, b]$ (its length, a priori a value in $[0, \infty]$) equals $\int_a^b \lVert \gamma'(t) \rVert \, dt$.
nodes.title: Length of a $C^1$ curve

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real Banach space, let $a \le b$ be real numbers and let $\gamma : \mathbb{R} \to E$ be continuously differentiable on $[a, b]$. Then the total variation of $\gamma$ on $[a, b]$, a priori a value in $[0, \infty]$, equals the real number $\int_a^b \lVert \gamma'_{[a,b]}(t) \rVert \, dt$, where $\gamma'_{[a,b]}(t)$ is the derivative of $\gamma$ at $t$ within $[a, b]$.
nodes.title: Length of a $C^1$ curve via its derivative within the interval

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real normed space, let $f : \mathbb{R} \to E$ be any function and let $a \le b$ be real numbers. Then $\int_a^b \lVert f'(t) \rVert \, dt = \int_a^b \lVert f'_{[a,b]}(t) \rVert \, dt$, where $f'(t)$ is the derivative of $f$ at $t$ and $f'_{[a,b]}(t)$ is its derivative at $t$ within $[a, b]$, each taken to be $0$ where it does not exist.
nodes.title: Integrating the norm of a derivative within a closed interval

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
